benefits.name: Anniversary Bonus Points
benefits.description: 6,000 bonus Rapid Rewards points awarded each account anniversary year.
benefits.terms: Points post automatically each account anniversary year.

benefits.name: Companion Pass Qualifying Points Boost
benefits.description: 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points credited each calendar year toward Southwest Companion Pass status.
benefits.terms: Boost is deposited by January 31st each calendar year and counts toward the Companion Pass qualifying points threshold.

benefits.name: 15% Annual Flight Discount Code
benefits.description: One 15% discount promo code delivered each account anniversary year, valid on base fares.
benefits.terms: Excludes Basic fares. Valid for one year from issuance.

benefits.name: First Checked Bag Free
benefits.description: First standard checked bag free for the primary cardmember and up to 8 passengers on the same reservation.
benefits.terms: Applies to reservations that include the cardmember.

benefits.name: Preferred Seat Selection
benefits.description: Complimentary preferred or standard seat selection within 48 hours of departure for the cardmember and up to 8 passengers, when available.

benefits.name: Group 5 Boarding
benefits.description: Group 5 boarding position for the cardmember and up to 8 additional passengers on the same reservation.

benefits.name: Inflight Purchase Rebate
benefits.description: 25% back as a statement credit on inflight Southwest Airlines purchases (drinks and WiFi).
benefits.terms: 25% rebate applied as a statement credit; no fixed annual cap disclosed.

benefits.name: A-List Tier Qualifying Points
benefits.description: Earn 2,000 Tier Qualifying Points (TQPs) toward Southwest A-List status for every $5,000 spent on purchases annually.
benefits.terms: 2,000 TQPs per $5,000 spent per calendar year.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: 12 months of complimentary DashPass membership, plus up to $10 off quarterly on eligible non-restaurant orders.
benefits.terms: Requires activation through Dec. 31, 2027 per current promotion; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it. Grants 12 months of DashPass plus quarterly $10 non-restaurant order credits.

benefits.name: Complimentary Instacart+ Membership
benefits.description: 3 months of complimentary Instacart+ membership plus a $10 monthly Instacart credit.
benefits.terms: Promotional benefit through Dec. 31, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: 3x Total Points on Lyft
benefits.description: Earn 3x total points on qualifying Lyft rides and services.
benefits.terms: Promotional rate through Dec. 31, 2027 per current terms; confirm this end date is still current before relying on it.

benefits.name: Free Employee Cards
benefits.description: Employee cards available at no additional cost, with individual spending limits set by the business owner.

earningRates.terms: Southwest Airlines purchases, including flights, inflight purchases, gift cards, and vacation packages.
First $8,000 in combined gas station and restaurant spend per calendar year, then 1x.
